newsitem.title: POLAND: GM denies Corsa assembly plans in Poland.
newsitem.headline: GM denies Corsa assembly plans in Poland.

text.p: A Polish unit of General Motors denied newspaper reports on Friday that it plans to assemble the company's Opel Corsa subcompact car at its Warsaw-based Zeran plant.
The unit's spokesman Zbigniew Lazar said journalists had misinterpreted a statement by the head of GM-Poland, Scott Mackie, at a news conference on Thursday.
"There are no plans to assemble Corsa at Zeran," Lazar said.
He added that the assembly of the popular Corsa at a planned factory in southern Poland of GM's German subsidiary Adam Opel AG was also unlikely.
But Lazar said the Warsaw plant was considering starting a second shift to boost production of the Astra model it now assembles.
